findings.title: Emphasised words in the plan cards and the checkbox label compete with the plan names and field labels

location.description: The plan card descriptions under Harbor and Marina, the label above the invoice address field and the line beside the checkbox

findings.viewer_experience: A few words inside running text are set as heavy as the plan names and field labels, so the eye jumps to them first and the headings of the cards stop leading.

current.value: Emphasised words in descriptions and labels have the same heavy weight as the plan names and field labels.

findings.target: The emphasised words are noticed but are clearly lighter than the plan names and field labels.
findings.fix_direction: Set the emphasis inside running interface text in a quieter way than the heavy weight used for headings and labels.
findings.source: Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style

closed_when.check: Look at the plan cards, the invoice address label and the checkbox line: the emphasised words do not look as heavy as the plan names and field labels.
